screened.name: Samia (French Marketing professional, Dubai)
screened.original:
Card teaser: "12 years of medical treatments had not helped her mental illness"

Issue: Samia was a recovering alcoholic who suffered great mental illness for a number of years. She was experiencing burnout and could not work. Her husband had suddenly asked for a divorce and she completely broke down. She moved countries to cope. He mental state was extremely fragile and she saw no hope for the future.

Healing: When I met Samia through a friend’s referral I was extremely concerned for her wellbeing. That very day I started her healing and my main goal was to get her to be a bit stable and feel some calm and peace within herself. At the end of that first session Samia seemed like a different person. Color returned to her cheeks and she actually smiled. In the subsequent weeks I dove deep into healing her past lives, her childhood and her family situation. Both her adult daughters were distant from her as the entire family had been thorough many years of difficulty. Her husband had moved on and that broke her.

Result: Within 2 weeks her daughter with whom she shared the house went from being angry and totally ignoring her mother to sitting in bed with her and sharing life while going out together and building a new relationship. Within a month Samia and her husband got on the same page and their relationship became more than cordial. After each week of healing Samia became mentally and spiritually stronger, she began to get out of bed and began a gym routine. She went out and made friends. Her sleep returned and she would wake up refreshed. Her self love returned and she began to do things that made her happy. She received an offer from someone to work together which she accepted as it would be slow paced. Samia and I continue to work together and though there is still some work left to do Samia is unrecognizable to herself and to her family.
screened.reason: Names mental illness, alcoholism and burnout, and the teaser claims '12 years of medical treatments had not helped' where healing did — disease-treatment plus superiority-over-medicine claims (RHPA s.30, s.74.01, YMYL). The relationship and lifestyle arc is safe and carries the story on its own.

We continue to work together, and Samia is unrecognizable to herself and to her family.

Card teaser: "Moved countries and anxiety around my future"

Issue: Shaneze had moved to Dubai a year ago and had a difficult task of succeeding in a highly competitive market. She was unable to sleep and lacked self confidence and suffered from anxiety and deep fear.

Healing: Samia referred her younger daughter whom she had moved in with. Knowing the history of the family well and getting to know Shaneze’s story, childhood trauma and feeling neglected and unloved needed to be healed. I needed to help instill her confidence and provide hope. Finances were very tight as there was no source of income in the new country.

Result: Shaneze worked very well with me and her intellect, maturity and desire to succeed were very helpful in her healing. She followed direction very well and moved beyond her limiting belief’s with ease. As her confidence soared she began attracting prospective clients and developing a strong network around her. Influential people reached out to her for partnerships. Even though her focus was establishing a business she wanted to have a loving committed relationship. Within 2 months she found a very suitable young man who treats her as she deserves. Overall Shaneze is feeling very stable, strong and looking forward to a great future ahead.
screened.reason: Frames anxiety, deep fear and inability to sleep as conditions the healing resolved (symptom-resolution claim); the result section also implies client-acquisition and partnership outcomes (secondary s.74.01 exposure). The confidence and relationship arc is retainable.
screened.softened: Shaneze had moved to Dubai a year ago with the difficult task of succeeding in a highly competitive market, and she was feeling fearful and unsure of herself. Her mother Samia referred her to me. Knowing the family's story well, I focused on the childhood wounds of feeling neglected and unloved, and on helping her rebuild confidence and hope. Shaneze worked very well with me — her intellect, maturity and desire to succeed carried her — and she moved beyond her limiting beliefs with ease. As her confidence grew she built a strong network around her and opened her heart to a loving committed relationship with a young man who treats her as she deserves. Today Shaneze feels stable, strong and is looking forward to a great future ahead.

screened.name: Gurtej (Engineer, Canada)
screened.original:
Card teaser: "Feel stuck, need new direction in career"

Issue: Gurtej had many ideas, dreams and was very ambitious but something was holding him back. He wanted to break free from his engineering corporate job and become self employed but did not have clarity on how to move forward. He was also diagnosed with Celiac disease.

Healing: Gurtej had been separated from his family at the tender age of 4 when he was adopted by his uncle so he could have a better life in Canada. That deep feeling of abandonment and lack of love, strong support and mentorship was missing from his life. Even though he developed resilience, the wounding was affecting him at the subconscious level. He could not move beyond his limiting belief’s. The healing sessions first addressed his rejection and abandonment wound and made space for expansion of his vision. A lot of time was spent on spiritual guidance as his mind opened to new frontiers for possibilities and manifestation.

Result: Overturning the Celiac diagnosis was a priority and the test that was already scheduled to be done a couple months after the healing sessions began provided amazing results- the markers went down from 93 to 17. The doctors were not able to explain this drastic improvement and Gurtej celebrated with his son by eating a Big Mac which he had to give up due to the Celiac diagnosis. He then received a promotion in a very desired role and is feeling happy and settled. He is still exploring starting a business and we are working on him gaining clarity and his why.
screened.reason: Claims the healing 'overturned' a Celiac disease diagnosis with blood markers dropping 93 to 17 that 'doctors were not able to explain,' and celebrates resuming gluten — an explicit disease-reversal claim that could lead a reader to abandon a medically necessary diet (RHPA s.30 harm clause, s.74.01, YMYL).
screened.softened: Gurtej had many ideas and dreams and was very ambitious, but something was holding him back from leaving his corporate engineering job to become self employed. Separated from his family at the tender age of 4 when he was adopted by his uncle so he could have a better life in Canada, a deep feeling of abandonment had stayed with him at the subconscious level. The healing sessions first addressed his rejection and abandonment wound and made space for expansion of his vision, and a lot of time was spent on spiritual guidance as his mind opened to new frontiers of possibility. Today Gurtej is feeling happy and settled in his work, and he is still exploring starting a business as we work on him gaining clarity and his why.

screened.name: Stuart (Gas Station owner, Canada)
screened.original:
Card teaser: "Being sued by TD bank……………………."

Issue: A past client called me to say that her husband who own a gas station was being accused by a major bank with whom his business shares a wall, that there was avery toxic smell in their premises likely due to a petrol was leak and the bank needed to be closed due to danger to their clients and staff. If proven to be the culprit, they would lose everything they had worked for their entire lives. The environmental authorities had begun investigations and soil samples and others were sent for testing. He had to close his business and was losing money daily while paying thousands of dollars for these testes that were being done by the government.

Healing: I took on the case but the pressure to heal and clear all issues within a short period of time was very critical. The other difficulty was that Stuart does not believe in healing or felt that this modality could help him. After a conversation though he was skeptical he gave his consent to me to proceed with the healing. I dove into deep healing of Stuart including generational and familial karma. There were many energetic and karmic blocks that were creating this and other issues in his life. His relationship with his wife were very strained too. He took it very hard as one can imagine and informed me that the servant had left their employment a couple years ago.

Result: The government had ordered multiple tests of the soil as well as the drums to see if there was leakage from there. The bank closed it’s doors for over a month and was looking at serious legal action towards Stuart and his business. After 6 sessions of healing every test result was negative and clear and the bank reopened for business. No explanation for the smell was ever found and the problem seemed to disappear as if by magic. Stuart was beyond relieved and happy with the result. His entire life’s work and savings were protected. Testimonial Ajita you saved me and my family I will never be able to repay what you did for me. No one thought I would come out of this. Thank you seems so feeble. What you do is amazing, keep up the great work.
screened.reason: Attributes clean government test results and the collapse of threatened legal action to 6 healing sessions ('every test result was negative,' 'you saved me and my family') — an implied concrete legal/financial outcome (s.74.01). The card teaser also names TD Bank, which is its own legal exposure and should be removed.
screened.softened: A past client called me about her husband Stuart, whose gas station business was facing a serious environmental investigation that threatened everything he had worked for his entire life. His business was closed and the pressure on him and his family was enormous. Stuart did not believe in healing and was very skeptical, but he gave his consent to proceed. I dove into deep healing including generational and familial karma, working through the many blocks that were weighing on him and on his strained relationships. Through the ordeal Stuart found a strength and calm that carried him and his family until the investigation ran its course and the business reopened. Testimonial: No one thought I would come out of this. You carried me and my family through it. Thank you seems so feeble. What you do is amazing, keep up the great work.

screened.name: Sundip (Actor, India)
screened.original:
Card teaser: "Success had eluded me and my relationships have caused me so much suffering"

Issue: Sundip has been an aspiring actor for many years and though he got a couple small roles in web series, he had not been able to get any substantial roles or be recognized for his talents. As he has a good voice he became a voice over artist and resigned to this fate. He was referred to me by a client whom I have worked with in my extended program and she kept insisting he work with me. Sundip has worked with a few psychologists and healers in the past and was reluctant as he had not gained anything from those sessions. Finally he relented and began working with me. He had numerous big blocks related to his childhood, almost all his significant and intimate relationships had been superficial and toxic creating a very low vibrational state within him. He had self-confidence issues and a great need to people please and be accepted. Inspite of being a very loving and giving person he had no stability nor happiness in his life. His financial crunch and lack of progress in his chosen field of work was causing him great distress.

Healing: There were a lot of layers of healing that were required. I began with his childhood and parental relationship. Cleaned latent deep seated feelings within the soul, mind and body of unworthiness, rejection, limiting belief’s and so much more. Cleared all energies from his past intimate relationships that were blocking the flow of positive energy. It was very important to find the reasons for the lack of success even thoughts he had all the skills and traits required for a good actor. Painstakingly I began unravelling that through an innate intuitive process.

Result: Sundip began to see results almost immediately. The first big win was that within a couple weeks he took his first international trip to Europe. Cleaning his energetic body of his past relationships enabled him to disconnect from the women physically and energetically and discontinue toxic cycles of energy exchange and repeated cycles. Within 4 weeks he began to get auditions and roles in movies. Talent scouts and others began to notice him and refer him to their contacts. Big directors were responding to him and within 4 months he had 3 movie roles and for 1 he travelled to Italy to shoot. His relationship with his father has improved. He is far more patient with him and they are being more a family and spending quality time together. Daily new professional contacts are being made and his prospects for new movies is increased exponentially. This is just the beginning for him. He has a very bright future ahead of him, and we continue to work together.
screened.reason: Attributes concrete career and income outcomes to the healing — auditions within 4 weeks, 3 movie roles in 4 months, talent scouts and big directors responding, prospects 'increased exponentially' — unsubstantiated performance claims under s.74.01. The emotional and relationship transformation is safe.
screened.softened: Sundip had been an aspiring actor for many years but felt unrecognized for his talents and had resigned himself to voice-over work. Referred by a client, he came to me reluctantly, having gained little from psychologists and healers in the past. He carried big blocks from his childhood, and almost all his intimate relationships had been superficial and toxic, leaving him with low self-confidence and a deep need to please. I began with his childhood and parental wounds, cleared the deep-seated feelings of unworthiness and rejection, and released the energies of past relationships that were weighing on him. Sundip felt the shift almost immediately — within a couple of weeks he took his first international trip to Europe. He broke free of toxic relationship cycles, his confidence returned, and his relationship with his father has warmed; they are being more of a family and spending quality time together. He is feeling hopeful and energized about his craft, and we continue to work together.

My focus was cleaning her energy of her childhood experiences and the pain and trauma that has resulted from her unhealthy lifestyle choices. screened.name: Maddy (Homemaker, Canada)
screened.original:
Card teaser: "I don’t want to have my Kidney stone surgery tomorrow morning"

Issue: Severe pain due to large kidney stone and she was set up for surgery at 8 am next morning. She called me as she did not want to go through surgery.

Healing: It was Sunday evening 8 pm and I had just returned from a day out and was reading dinner. Normally I would never answer a phone call at that time of the night but I was guided to do so and it was Maddy sounding really bad calling from her hospital bed sobbing. Maddy told me she had a very large kidney stone and was due for surgery within 12 hours but shoe did not want to go ahead with it, and asked me to help her to not have the surgery in the morning. I was quite shocked by her request as it seemed irresponsible to cancel and seemingly much required surgery. Also due to the too late hour to cancel surgery that was scheduled less than 12 hours away with all preparations that would have be made and everything in place to go ahead including surgeons, operating theatres, anesthetists etc Her daughter and son who are doctors were by her side. She was very insistent I help her and reluctantly I agreed. I asked my husband to order dinner and I began an hour long healing process clearing all her blockages and clearing a path to the surgery being cancelled in the morning and her being sent home. Also my main focus was that her pain subside and the stone pass naturally and painlessly as soon as possible.

Result: I spoke to Maddy at11:00 am the next morning and she informed me that the doctors had somehow decided to cancel the surgery and were sending her home after another dose of morphine and other drugs in the hope that she would pass the stone naturally in the next few days. She is now pain free with no kidney stones.
screened.reason: Claims healing led to a scheduled surgery being cancelled and kidney stones resolving pain-free — this is the highest-risk item on the site because it models avoiding medically indicated surgery (RHPA s.30 harm clause at its core, plus s.74.01 and YMYL). Recommend removing this story entirely; the softened version below strips every reference to the surgery outcome, but even so this narrative adds little that is safe.
screened.softened: Maddy called me one Sunday evening from her hospital bed, sobbing and frightened about a procedure scheduled for the next morning. I would normally never answer a call at that hour, but I was guided to do so. I asked my husband to order dinner and spent an hour in healing with her, focused on easing her fear and helping her feel calm and supported through whatever the morning would bring. When we spoke the next day she was in a completely different state of mind — peaceful, and deeply grateful for the comfort she felt that night.

screened.name: Mobeka (Training Specialist, UK)
screened.original:
Card teaser: "Help my sister suffers from depression and autoimmune hepatitis"

Issue: Deeply unhappy recently diagnosed with autoimmune hepatitis, Diabetes, obesity, high blood pressure, in a severe financial crunch. Was holding a deep dark secret- sexual abuse for 8 years by a home teacher which she had never shared with anyone.

Healing: Mobeka was referred to me by her sister who had seen amazing results with the healing her mother had experienced with me. When I first spoke to Marietta she was in a very helpless state. Her health was failing and the autoimmune hepatitis diagnosis which has no cure was causing her great anxiety. The first thing she said to be was- “I feel like snakes are crawling inside me, I cannot stand it” She mentioned to me that she had not felt happiness for the last 20 years. She was feeling stuck in her career and was in a part time position not making enough money to make her ends meet. Even though she was married to a good man she was feeling very unfulfilled in that marriage and had no children. Her relationship with her parents and sister was also very strained and she felt unloved and uncared for and put down all the time. After a couple of weeks when she felt secure enough with me, Mobeka shared a very painful part of her life- when she was 10 years old her home tutor began to inappropriately touch her which went on until she was 18 years old. She had never shared this with anybody and had continued to carry the pain and the shame all by herself.

Result: Mobeka dove into the healing sessions with me with great commitment. She followed all my instructions, did her meditations and other practices that I prescribed diligently. The first thing that happened was the snakes she felt slithering inside her body quietened down. Within the first couple of weeks even though she had traveled back to India from London and was surrounded by family and related stress she actually managed it a lot better than she had in the past. In 4 weeks her anxiety cleared the lot and she began to feel hopeful for her future. 6 weeks into her healing program she had a doctor’s appointment where they were very happy with her test results. When she came to me she had been prescribed 3 immunosuppressant tablets a day but during that visit the doctor reduced her dosage to one tablet a day. Her diabetes and blood pressure were within the normal range as well. when she told me that she was beginning to feel happy, something that she had not felt in the last 20 years. On the career front- she was filling in a temporary position for a woman who was transferred to a different department. After 10 sessions Mobeka was informed that she was being made permanent and full-time in her current position with a nice pay increase. After she shared her sexual trauma with me we explored whether it was safe and wise to share it with her husband and she was to think about it and we were to discuss its merits the following week in our session. But within an hour she messaged me that she had already told her husband. He had been very supportive but was extremely angry with the person who had caused her all this pain. Mobeka was very happy and relieved that she no longer needed to hide or keep this big secret from her husband. Through the work that we were doing and all the counseling she was receiving she began to feel stronger within herself and learn to stand up when her family did not treat her right. Her deep rooted issues eroded her self confidence which improved tremendously and she was more assertive at work and that allowed her to be seen and she began getting more responsibilities and her prospects increased. Thrilled with her 3 month results Mobeka wanted to continue working on her personal growth so enrolled in my extended program. We began to work on her weight issues and other aspects that required healing. She continues her evolutionary journey, her health issues are well under control and shines.
screened.reason: Names autoimmune hepatitis, depression, diabetes, obesity and high blood pressure, and claims a doctor cut immunosuppressant dosage from 3 tablets to 1 after healing, with diabetes and blood pressure normalizing — a medication-reduction and disease-management claim, the clearest RHPA s.30 breach in the case studies. Also includes 'prescribed' language, which implies a controlled act. The emotional arc (sharing her secret, feeling happy after 20 years) is powerful and fully retainable.
screened.softened: Mobeka was referred to me by her sister after their mother's experience with my healing. When I first spoke to her she was in a very helpless state — she told me she had not felt happiness for the last 20 years. She felt stuck in her career, unfulfilled, and unloved and put down by the family around her. After a couple of weeks, when she felt secure enough with me, she shared a very painful secret she had carried alone since childhood. Mobeka dove into the healing sessions with great commitment, doing her meditations and practices diligently. She found the courage to share her secret with her husband, who was deeply supportive, and felt enormous relief at no longer carrying it alone. She began to feel stronger within herself, learned to stand up for herself when her family did not treat her right, and grew more confident and assertive at work. Then came the day she told me she was beginning to feel happy — something she had not felt in 20 years. Thrilled with her progress, Mobeka enrolled in my extended program and continues her evolutionary journey. She shines.
